title: John Mack's experiencer support group and its two camps

tellings.quote: when I went to his support groups, I noticed that they were in my from my perspective, I saw two different camps of people.

plain: The people in a support group for those who say they were taken by aliens, run in the Boston area by the psychiatrist John Mack, split into two different camps, according to Jim Weiner. Weiner, who appears on the show as an abduction witness, says he went to the groups himself and noticed this division, though he does not spell out here what set the two camps apart. His point is that the people reporting these experiences do not all see them the same way.
